name: Computer control
summary: Lets Alexia see what is on screen, press things, move the mouse and type. Anything a person at this keyboard could do.

requires.why: To see your screen — a picture of it, and the list of what is on it and where.
To press things, move the mouse, click, and type on your keyboard as if you were doing it.
To ask the computer itself to do those things — PowerShell on Windows, osascript on a Mac.
To put the screenshots somewhere. They are deleted when you delete this plugin.
To ask Laya on this computer, and TypeSafe when you add a key, which control on screen a step means.

settings.label: Allow her to press things, move the mouse and type
settings.hint: Off means she can look but not touch: no clicking, no mouse, no typing. Turn this on only while you are watching.

settings.label: How she finds buttons
settings.hint: Alexia writes the whole plan first, then carries it out. Each button is found by its name or what it is (the search box, the first video); this chooses who breaks a tie when two could fit.

options.label: Fast (recommended)
options.hint: Laya on this computer breaks ties, then Jev if you have a key. If neither is sure she stops and says so.

options.label: Names only
options.hint: No Laya and no Jev: only a button whose name or role plainly fits is pressed.

settings.label: Use Laya
settings.hint: A small free model that runs on this computer and finds the right button in tens of milliseconds. Set it up once by asking Alexia to set up Laya (about 2 GB).

options.label: Typed decisions
options.hint: The newest, trained on exactly this kind of choice. Best for most windows.

options.label: Multilingual
options.hint: Reads buttons in Czech and 100 other languages better, and is faster.

options.label: Let Laya pick
options.hint: Chooses English or multilingual by the language on screen.

settings.label: Start Laya with Alexia
settings.hint: Keeps Laya loaded so the first task does not wait for it. Off means it only runs when you start it.

settings.label: Where Laya runs
settings.hint: Leave it as it is unless you run Laya's server yourself on another port.

settings.label: Laya key
settings.hint: Only if you run Laya's server yourself with a key (LAYA_API_KEY). Otherwise leave it empty.

settings.label: TypeSafe key (optional)
settings.hint: Adds Jev as a backup for when Laya is not sure, and to check Laya in apps it is new to. From console.typesafe.ai. It goes to this machine's credential store, never to the database.

settings.label: Most to spend on Jev a day (USD)
settings.hint: A step costs a small fraction of a cent. Past this, Jev rests until tomorrow and Alexia's model takes its place.

settings.label: Screenshots to keep
settings.hint: Older ones are deleted. Zero keeps none once she is done with them.

settings.label: Open web pages in
settings.hint: Every page she opens goes to this browser, so she always finds it where she left it.

widgets.label: Now
widgets.hint: The plan for the task she is doing, ticked off step by step. The last one stays here when she is done.

widgets.label: Take over
widgets.hint: She stops before her next step so you can use the computer.

widgets.label: Continue
widgets.hint: She looks at the screen again and carries on from where she was.

widgets.label: Do it again
widgets.hint: Runs the last plan again, with no AI model asked.

widgets.label: Save as plan
widgets.hint: Keeps the last plan under its goal.

widgets.label: Saved sequences
widgets.hint: Steps she has done before, repeated without paying an AI model to work them out again.
